name: MDCPM
summary: MDCPM, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-cyclopropylmethylamphetamine or as N-cyclopropylmethyl-MDA, is a drug. It is the N-cyclopropylmethyl derivative of MDMA.

fact.en: Its nitrogen carries a cyclopropylmethyl group, a tiny three-carbon ring on a short arm. The same group sits on the nitrogen of the opioid drugs naltrexone and buprenorphine.
fact.zh: 它的氮原子上接著一個環丙基甲基，也就是短臂末端的小型三碳環。同樣的基團也出現在鴉片類藥物納曲酮與丁基原啡因的氮原子上。
fact.zhHans: 它的氮原子上接着一个环丙基甲基，也就是短臂末端的小型三碳环。同样的基团也出现在鸦片类药物纳曲酮与丁基原啡因的氮原子上。
